Class-Based Language Model Features.description: Features comprising at least one token appearing in a defined position in a model feature comprising a grouping of tokens of a given length n.

GEO_UNI_FIRST.description: A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length one relating to a geographic term.

GEO_BI_FIRST.description: A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a geographic term.

GEO_BI_SECOND.description: A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a geographic term.

GEO_TRI_FIRST.description: A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a geographic term.

GEO_TRI_SECOND.description: A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a geographic term.

GEO_TRI_THIRD.description: A class-based language model feature for the third token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a geographic term.

ST_UNI_FIRST.description: A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length one relating to a search term.

ST_BI_FIRST.description: A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a search term.

ST_BI_SECOND.description: A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a search term.

ST_TRI_FIRST.description: A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a search term.

ST_TRI_SECOND.description: A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a search term.

ST_TRI_THIRD.description: A class-based language model feature for the third token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a search term.

records.description: The query parser derivation computing device defines class-based language model features.
The query parser derivation computing device utilizes the class-based language model features as high-level language model features in deriving the query parser.
The class-based language model features include GEO_UNI_FIRST.
The class-based language model features include GEO_BI_FIRST.
The class-based language model features include GEO_BI_SECOND.
